description:
Compare 2–6 activities side by side: date, type, duration, distance, pace/speed, heart rate, power (avg/NP), elevation, training effect and load, cadence, and efficiency factor (speed or NP per heartbeat; higher means more output for the same heart rate, a classic way to track aerobic progress on similar sessions).

With deep=true, also analyzes each one's FIT data (downloads files if needed): aerobic decoupling, time in low/moderate/high HR zones and best efforts.

Example: "Am I getting fitter on my Tuesday interval run?" → list those runs, then compare them.

deep.description: Also run FIT-based analysis for each activity

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for complete structured data

name: garmin_compare_activities
title: Compare activities
